request.content:
Requests:
[t0] I am asking you to remove my account and the personal information linked to it. Please review any identifiers connected to this account as part of the request. I would appreciate confirmation of the final outcome.
[t1] I am asking you to remove my account and the personal information linked to it. Please review any identifiers connected to this account as part of the request. Let me know when the request has been completed.
[t2] I am requesting deletion of the account registered to this email address. Please follow the applicable retention and deletion requirements for the account. Please let me know once the request has been reviewed.
[t3] I am requesting deletion of the account registered to this email address. Please handle any copies that fall within the scope of the deletion request. Please send a confirmation after the process finishes.
[t4] I no longer use this account and would like it permanently deleted. Please ensure the request is applied to the relevant account records. A short confirmation when the process is complete is sufficient.
[t5] I no longer use this account and would like it permanently deleted. Please ensure the request is applied to the relevant account records. I would appreciate confirmation of the final outcome.
[t6] I want to close this account and have its associated personal data deleted. Please complete the normal identity and data review for this request. A short confirmation when the process is complete is sufficient.
[t7] I want to close this account and have its associated personal data deleted. Please complete the normal identity and data review for this request. I would appreciate confirmation of the final outcome.
[t8] I would like the account associated with this address to be erased. Please handle any copies that fall within the scope of the deletion request. Please confirm the result after completing the required checks.
[t9] I would like the account associated with this address to be erased. Please handle any copies that fall within the scope of the deletion request. Please confirm when the review is complete.
[t10] I would like to submit a request to delete this account and its personal data. Please ensure the request is applied to the relevant account records. Please confirm the result after completing the required checks.
[t11] I would like to submit a request to delete this account and its personal data. Please ensure the request is applied to the relevant account records. Please contact me if you need information to verify the request.
[t12] My account page is gone, but my old profile still appears when I search for it. Can you remove that search result too?
[t13] My surname is misspelled on the account. Can you correct it without removing any of my records?
[t14] Please close my account and process the associated personal-data deletion. Please check the records connected to the account before confirming completion. I would appreciate confirmation of the final outcome.
[t15] Please close my account and process the associated personal-data deletion. Please check the records connected to the account before confirming completion. Please contact me if you need information to verify the request.
[t16] Please erase the account linked to this email address. Please check the records connected to the account before confirming completion. Let me know when the request has been completed.
[t17] Please erase the account linked to this email address. Please check the records connected to the account before confirming completion. Please contact me if you need information to verify the request.
[t18] Please permanently delete the account associated with this email address. Please apply the request across the systems covered by your deletion policy. Please confirm the result after completing the required checks.
[t19] Please permanently delete the account associated with this email address. Please check the records connected to the account before confirming completion. A short confirmation when the process is complete is sufficient.
[t20] Please process a permanent account-deletion request for this email address. Please apply the request across the systems covered by your deletion policy. Please contact me if you need information to verify the request.
[t21] Please process a permanent account-deletion request for this email address. Please check the records connected to the account before confirming completion. Please confirm the result after completing the required checks.
[t22] Please treat this message as a request for permanent account deletion. Please apply the request across the systems covered by your deletion policy. I would appreciate confirmation of the final outcome.
[t23] Please treat this message as a request for permanent account deletion. Please apply the request across the systems covered by your deletion policy. Let me know when the request has been completed.
[t24] Please treat this message as a request for permanent account deletion. Please review the account data that is eligible for deletion or de-identification. Let me know when the request has been completed.
[t25] Please treat this message as a request for permanent account deletion. Please review the account data that is eligible for deletion or de-identification. Please let me know once the request has been reviewed.
